title: Karaoke Club
description: Active vocal performance combined with lyric analysis, targeted pronunciation spotlights, and communicative challenges.

songs.title: Take On Me
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Practice singing or speaking smooth vowel transitions and high pitch slides on phrases like 'shining away' and 'coming for your love'.

songs.title: Sweet Child O' Mine
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Focus on crisp rhythm and sustained vocal resonance on open vowel sounds during high melody lines.

songs.title: Billie Jean
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Emphasize staccato consonants (p, t, k) and rhythmic syncopation across fast-paced vocal lines.

songs.title: Count On Me
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Focus on clear enunciation of final consonants and friendly, conversational intonation.

songs.title: Someone Like You
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Practice connected speech and breath support across long melodic phrases.

songs.title: Shallow
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Master dynamic contrast between quiet conversational verses and powerful belt choruses.

songs.title: Let It Go
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Focus on expressive vocal projection and distinct pronunciation of 's' and 't' ending sounds.

songs.title: You're Welcome
songs.pronunciation_prompt: Practice rapid cadence, rhythmic timing, and cheerful storytelling tone.
